reasons.overallMobile: Coherent atmospheric mission with useful mobile guidance and clear progress feedback. Manual twin-contact combat worked, but aiming corrections, small targets, offscreen threat locating and uncertain phase timing kept it from feeling consistently effortless in these samples.
reasons.controls: MOVE and FIRE drag together and scene swipes visibly worked in both attempts, including patrol combat. Wider opening drag produced an armor-hit failure requiring retap. Assistance is substantial; continuous hold rearming and physical thumb comfort were not established.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, phased coils and uplink defense supply distinct visible tasks and readable success states. Route assists made traversal straightforward but sometimes reduced spatial understanding; two phase-window failures required waiting/correction. Unassessed tactics and memory reading not included in enjoyment judgment.
reasons.presentation: Strong rain-soaked industrial atmosphere, restrained teal/gold feedback, cohesive title and terminal layout. Some hard black bands/occluding structures and dark distant geometry reduce scene clarity.
reasons.usability: Large touch buttons, contextual approach label, understandable planning map and full terminal assist breakdown. Dense lower control cluster and occasional wall-facing assisted movement add friction; settings/tool flows not sampled.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and objective text legible at 390x844; coil labels and terminal stats clear. Small distant enemies and fine sign/map legend text take effort; dark geometry blends.
